rule: art-src/<path>/<name>.png -> art-src/3d/<path>/<name>.glb (ships: art-src/ships/ship-NN-<id>-2d.png -> art-src/3d/ships/ship-NN-<id>.glb; skills/ and items/ hold Text to 3D models with no 2D image). Owner originals from Tripo/Meshy, never edited; pipelines read them and write processed copies elsewhere. Regenerate: node scripts/models/index-3d-sources.mjs

noOriginalOnThisMachine.heroes/draconis, heroes/draconis-v2, her: Only the packaged runtime copies in public/assets/space-typing/models remain. The Meshy originals were on the old Windows machine (D:\typing-game\games\space-typing\art-src\models\raw\heroes\, art-src\models\heroes\). If found, save them as art-src/3d/heroes/<id>.glb.
noOriginalOnThisMachine.enemies/rainbow-scout-3d: Only the packaged runtime copy remains (the Campaign 3D scout of the first slice, made from art-src/enemies/rainbow-scout.png; once at art-src/concepts/enemies/rainbow-scout-3d.glb on the Windows machine). If found, save it as art-src/3d/enemies/rainbow-scout.glb: that also replaces the rainbow-scout placeholder.
noOriginalOnThisMachine.skills/dragon-fireball: Only the packaged runtime copy remains (once at art-src/concepts/attack/fire-ball.glb on the Windows machine). It has no 2D image: if found, save it as art-src/3d/skills/dragon-fireball.glb.
noOriginalOnThisMachine.bosses/auriel-hero: Built from art-src/3d/bosses/tyrant-g01.glb with --hero-clips; only the intermediate Blender file is missing.
